text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with Seiun 
Sky, I spotted King Halo doting on a stray 
cat.

text_block_list.name: White Cat
text_block_list.text: Meow... Purrrr...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huh. You sure are well-loved, King.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho, naturally! Even cats can't resist 
the charm of a true King!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
This Beatrix in particular is super smart! 
She trusted me right away and let me pet 
her!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, Beatrix, is it? ...Fufu, you've gone 
and given it another grand name, haven't 
you?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Leo! You're in high spirits today too, 
I see!

text_block_list.name: White Cat
text_block_list.text: Meow.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Gah!? L-Leo...?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Heh~, El calls it by a different name, 
huh? Well, that's pretty common for stray 
cats.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... El! Would you please stop calling 
my Beatrix by made-up names?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¿Qué!? What's this 'Beatrix' thing?! This 
boy's name is Leo!

text_block_list.name: White Cat
text_block_list.text: Mew?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Look! I just answered you!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Grrr... I won't accept that! The name 
befitting this little one is Beatrix!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, don't get so heated. You'll 
trouble the poor kitty, you know?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
So here's my proposal! How about we try 
calling kitty's name at the same time?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
If we do that, the kitty should naturally 
approach whichever of us it feels closer 
to.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, so we're settling this once and for 
all, YES?! BRING. IT. OOOON!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Of course I accept the challenge! This 
girl's number one is King! The King 
herself!

And so, the contest began, but... a winner 
wasn't decided easily.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Leo! Leo! Please come over here!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: "Beatrix! Remember the day we first met!"

text_block_list.name: White Cat
text_block_list.text: ...Myaah...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, she looks a bit annoyed. Maybe we 
should stop before it gets worse...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Shiro. Come here.

text_block_list.name: White Cat
text_block_list.text: Meoow♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Wha...?! Wh-Why are you with Sky-san?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Truth is, I'm friends with this 
little one tooâª We've known each other 
since I first came to the academy, in 
fact.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: NOOOOO! Leo, was I just a game to you?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ngggh... Beatrix, why didn't you meet me 
sooner...?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh... It seems the match has 
already been decided!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh... It seems the match has 
already been decided!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, I know, right~?♪ It was quite a 
long journey to get this far.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"First off, when you interact with 
kitties, you can't think about keeping 
them all to yourself. You have to approach 
them with a spirit of service, like 
this..."

text_block_list.name: White Cat
text_block_list.text: Mewww...♪

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oooh!? It rolled right over and showed its 
belly!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"After all, I'm the one being allowed to 
fluff them up. I have to make sure they 
feel totally relaxed and happy."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
See, like this, rub their belly 
vigorously. Alright, everyone, let's give 
it a try~!

Afterward, the three of us took an 
intensive Beginner's Cat Course from 
Professor Seiun Sky...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, that's up to the kitty to decide. How 
about we ask for its permission first?

Told by Seiun Sky, I reached out my 
hand... The white cat sniffed it, and 
promptly turned away.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh! That means you've earned their trust. 
Maybe they'll even let you fluff 'em up 
someday.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Uuu... Sei-chan, you are like a true 
maestra...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Kh, I will overcome this eventually...! 
I'm definitely going to become this 
child's number one...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if you can climb all the way up 
to Sei-chan's heights~? Fufufu...
